title: Kim and the Empty Row
synopsis: Kim visits the now-empty radish row and sees a beetle and moving leaf shadows, while keeping the three special stones in her pouch.
continuity_state: Before: The radishes have been harvested, the red row label remains, and the garden sign now stands in its new readable spot. Kim still has exactly three pouch pebbles. After: Kim notices a beetle and shifting sunflower-leaf shadows in the bare front row but puts nothing in the soil. Her pouch still contains all three pebbles, including the striped one. Grandma May says no new planting has been decided yet. The existing stepping stones and moved sign are unchanged.
